content: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position description Sonar is looking for a customer-centric Platform Product Manager to drive the foundational capabilities that make our products enterprise-ready, trusted by the world’s largest organizations and truly loved by developers around the world. You will be part of the Product Management team that drives the vision and roadmaps for our core platform infrastructure. We are currently looking for Product Managers with a deep technical background in enterprise SaaS capabilities. This role sits at the intersection of core infrastructure and customer needs. As a Product Manager, you will shape our platform's core pillars to deliver an enterprise-grade, seamless experience our customers can trust. To achieve this perfect match, we need a passionate Product Manager who will research, clarify, prioritize the needs of external IT administrators, DevOps, and security teams, and translate those needs across our product line. You will become an expert user of our core platform, from very high-level user settings down to the technical aspects of our infrastructure. Position description Sonar is looking for a passionate product design generalist to join our Product Design team, which owns the experience for our robust platform of code quality and security products. You will belong to one of our product areas, where you’ll help ensure that our developer and agent users write better code and have a seamless experience in the product. You will work closely with Product Management and Engineering to ensure that the proposed solutions meet the expected outcome and that we collectively deliver the best products to help development teams write better and more secure code. You will also collaborate with other designers and researchers across the organization, ensuring consistency and contributing to best practices.

Position description You will work on pioneering projects that advance the application of AI within the realm of software engineering. This role offers the opportunity to conduct cutting-edge research, develop novel algorithms and contribute to the development of software tools that enhance system performance, reliability, and flexibility. Your work will directly impact the efficiency and effectiveness of our AI products, enabling developers to spend less time fixing issues and more time innovating. You will contribute to the creation of accessible, user-friendly, and performant solutions that integrate seamlessly with our existing infrastructure.

Position description We are hiring an O2C Revenue Analyst to support the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of data flowing through Sonar’s order-to-cash and revenue accounting processes. This role focuses on extracting, transforming, validating, and loading Salesforce CPQ data into Aptitude RevStream (AREV), investigating data exceptions, and reconciling billing information to the revenue subledger. Working closely with Revenue Accounting, Billing Operations, and BizTech, you will apply strong data processing skills, advanced Excel capabilities, SQL reporting knowledge, and hands-on AREV experience to support monthly and quarterly closes. You will help investigate transactions requiring additional calculations or system configuration, with accounting conclusions and configuration changes reviewed by the appropriate process owners. This role will also strengthen team coverage through cross-training, clear process documentation, and knowledge sharing. Your work will help reduce reliance on individual process owners, improve data quality and controls, and build a more efficient and scalable revenue processing workflow. Position description We are seeking a Revenue Finance Director to join our FP&A team and own how Sonar forecasts, plans, and prices its revenue. You will drive forecast accuracy, partner cross-functionally to optimize revenue, and give executives clear recommendations on revenue strategy. This is a hands-on role for a self-starter who pushes back with data, builds their own solutions, and leads our AI-first approach to FP&A. What you will do Own the Revenue Forecast and Raise Its AccuracyOwn Sonar’s revenue forecast end to end (bookings, billings, and revenue) across monthly and quarter-end cycles, with a clear view of where we will land and why.Treat forecast accuracy as your personal scorecard.
